tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅: dhā ki gtsug gi rgyan gcig ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi sgrub pa bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈྈྈ gu ru kun bzang yab yum la phyag 'tshal lo: gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas la mon mkhar steng du: mon mo bkra shis 'dren gyis gser skyogs g.yus bkang ba gcig phul nas zhus pa: gu ru pad+ma he ru ka: he ru ka dang yang dag sbyor: jo mo ma gcig mtsho rgyal 'di: bdag sogs kun la drin che bas: gtsug gi rgyan gcig rnal 'byor ma: thang cig ma dang gnas 'gyangs tshe: rang rig gser dang 'dra ba 'dis: ma gcig bsgrub cing gsol 'debs gang: bdag sogs phyi rabs don ched du: gu ru nyid kyis gsung bar zhu'o: zhes phyag dang bskor ba mang du byas nas zhus pas: gu rus dgyes bzhin du bka' bstsal pa: nyon cig dad ldan snod ldan ma: mtshan ldan ḍā ki/ 'od 'chang sprul pa khyod nyon cig: de don khyod kyis zhus pa legs: mtsho rgyal ma gcig 'dug pa 'di: lha mo sgrol ma'i sprul pa yin: sngon ni gaṅgā'i lha mo yin: da lta bod mo'i cha lugs bzhugs: phyi ltar yum chen mtsho rgyal ma: nang ltar ma gcig mtsho rgyal ma: gsang ba ma mo bdag med ma: 'di nyid bsgrub cing gsol 'debs na: phyi nang gsang ba'i tshul du bsgrub: ces gsungs so: gleng slong gnang ba'i skabs phye ba'i le'u ste dang po'o: ྈྈྈ gu ru chen po pad+ma la: bkra shis 'dren gyis yang zhus pa: jo mo'i phyi sgrub ji ltar lags: gu ru chen pos 'di skad gsungs: snod ldan dad brtson the tshom spang: dben pa bkra shis dge gnas su: sa gtsang yid 'ong maṇ+ḍal bsham: phyogs tshon pad+ma 'dab bzhi bri: tshom bu lha lnga bskyed la dgram: skyabs su 'gro zhing sems bskyed bya: de nas stong gsal 'gag med bsgom: stong pa'i ngang las rang rig sems: ma dmar mig nang hrīḥyis mtshan: ma de'i 'od las pad 'dab bzhi: gzhal yas lhun stug nang du ni: pad steng ma bsam 'od 'phros pas: phyogs bzhi'i pad 'dab steng du ni: ha ri ni sa rnam bzhi bsam: hrīḥm ha ri ni sa zhes brjod pas:

ma gcig jo mo mkhar chen ma: sku mdog dkar la dmar chags pa: lha mo zhal mdzes gzi brjid can: thor cog 1$0000230 phyed bcings/1$0000300phyed bkrol dar lngas brgyan: phyag gnyis thal sbyar snyim pa na: nor bu rin chen dgos 'dod skong: yid 'ong zhabs gnyis skyil krung bzhugs: sku gsung thugs las 'od gsum 1$0000230 dkar dmar mthing*/1$0000300'phros: bdag gi gnas gsum dag tu phog: lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa sbyangs: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob:1$0000230 par bsam/ 1$0000300thugs dkyil ma bsam ma nang hrī: o rgyan pad+ma bdag nyid bsam: sprul sku'i cha lugs gzi brjid can: 'od ldan byin dang ldan par bsam: ha ri ni sa yig bzhi las: na gzhon bu mo mdzes sdug bzhi: gser dngul rat+na'i phreng bas brgyan: dar gyi cod pan rnam lnga 'phur: phyag g.yas thod pa'i ḍā ru 'khrol: phyag g.yon thod pas dgos 'dod skong: gar stabs sgyur zhing dngos grub 'beb: de rnams kun las 'od zer ni: lcags kyu lta bur 'phros pa las: bskyed dang 'dra ba rang bzhin gsal: sa mā ti yis spyan drangs bstim: rang nyid mdun du de ltar bsam: dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: mchod gtor bdun pa rnam dag bya: de nas skal ldan sgrub pa po: ma yengs rab tu gus pa yis: gsol ba 'di ltar gdab par bya: oṃ āḥhūm̐: a ma jo mo: jo mo la gsol ba 'debs so: ma gcig yum chen gos dkar mo: mdangs ldan ma la gsol ba 'debs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: a ma jo mo: jo mo la gsol= ma gcig yum chen kun sgrol ma: 'gro kun sgrol la gsol ba 'debs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: 'gre'o: ma gcig jo mo rnal 'byor ma: bdag med ston la gsol= oṃ= ma gcig jo mo mtsho rgyal ma: las can skyong la gsol= oṃ= ma gcig ye shes lnga ldan ma: ye shes lnga yi dbang skur cig: oṃ= ma gcig gter gyi mnga' bdag mo: thugs gter gsang ba'i sgo phyes shig:

oṃ= ma gcig yid bzhin nor 'chang ma: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ= mkha' 'gro sde bzhi ma gcig 'khor: phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro 'dul mdzod: oṃ= mkha' 'gro tshad med bzhi ldan ma: ngan song skyob la gsol ba 'debs: oṃ= ma gcig khams gsum dbang sdud ma: lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du sdus: oṃ āḥhūm̐: a ma jo mo: jo mo la gsol ba 'debs so: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥm ha ri ni sa sarba sid+dhi pha la ho: zhes bzlas gsol ba btab rjes la: rang gi gtsug tu spyan drangs bstim: byin brlabs bdag gi rnam shes ldang: rjes la mi rtog ngang la bzhag: yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bskang: 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab: de ltar sgrubs shig dge ldan ma: de ltar bsgrubs pa'i byin rlabs kyang: lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa sbyong: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob: dngos grub rnam gnyis gter sgo 'byed: las rnams kun bsgrub sngon du 'gro: dam tshig nyams chag thams cad skong: de phyir phyi sgrub 'di la 'bad: ces gsungs so: ma gcig jo mo'i phyi sgrub kyi le'u ste gnyis pa'o: sa ma ya: gu ru chen po pad+ma la: bkra shis 'dren gyis yang zhus pa: ma gcig gtsug gi rgyan gcig ma'i: jo mo'i nang sgrub bshad du gsol: gu ru chen pos bka' bstsal pa: nyon cig skal ldan dge sems ma: dam tshig gtsang ldan las can gyis: dur khrod mkha' 'gro'i 'du gnas su: maṇ+ḍal dpe'u chung bzhin du bsham: sman rag gtor gsum mchod rdzas bsham: rnga dang dril bu ḍā ru rkang: gsur dud mar me rus rgyan bsham: pad+ma brtsegs pa'i gtor ma dang: jo mo'i sku ni dpe chung ltar: brjid ldan sin+dhu ra yis bris: mtshams gcad rim pa 'di lta ste: rang nyid khro bo'i nga rgyal gyis: bka' bsgo gsang sngags 'di skad brjod: oṃ pad+ma kro dhī shwa rī badz+ra kī li kī la ya: ma hā yak+ṣa kā la rū pa karma raṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa:

brgya rtsa brgyad pas bgegs rnams brlag: nyams chag sdig dang gnong 'gyod rnams: yi ge brgya pas bshags par bya: sman dang rak+ta gtor ma rnams: byin gyis brlabs kyis sbyang spel ba: oṃ dang āḥ dang hūm̐ dang gsum: lan gcig brjod pas stong par bsam: lan gcig spel la lan gcig gis: bdud rtsi ba liṃ rak+ta dang: 'dod yon lnga ldan mchod par bsam: tshogs rnams raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gsum gyis: bsregs sbyangs bkrus dang dag par bsam: oṃ dang āḥdang hūm̐ gsum gyis: tshogs 'khor 'dod yon lngar spel lo: de nas bskyed pa'i rim pa ni: thog mar byang chub sems bskyed nas: skad cig ma yi sa mā ti: dngos rnams mi dmigs mkha' 'dra bar: pad+ma dmar po 'dab bzhi'i dbus: ma bsam ma las 'od 'phros pas: ha ri ni sa dmar po bzhi: pad+ma 'dab bzhir rim par bsam: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥm gu ru rkyen zlog drag mo rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dza: ha ri ni sa hūm̐ sid+dhi pha la ho: bya ba'i gsang sngags de brjod pas: rang nyid jo mo rnal 'byor ma: gcer bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma: g.yas pa dbang sdud phyag rgya can: g.yon pas thod khrag rin chen bsnams: bcu drug na tshod rus rgyan can: dbu skra phyed grol sku mdog dmar: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum nyi zla brdzis: zhi ma khro tshul thugs ka na: pad+ma 'dab bzhi dmar dkyil hrī: rta mgrin zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: rgyan med phyag g.yas dbang sdud can: g.yon pa'i zhags pas thams cad 'gugs: dbu gtsug rta mgo rta skad 'tsher: rnam pa rta mgrin 'dra mod kyang: ngo bo o rgyan nga ru bsam: 'dab bzhir ma las yi ge bzhi: dhā ki bzhi yi ngo bor bsam: gsang sngags sgrog dang gsol gdab tshe: de rnams kun las 'od 'phros pas: pheṃ pheṃ hrīḥyi sgra dang bcas: 'od zer stong gsum gang bar bsam: snang srid dbang sdud dngos grub kyi: char 'beb 'gro drug 'dul bar bsam: gzhal yas 'dab bzhi'i yig bzhi las: mkha' 'gro sde bzhi dmar mor bskyed:

de yang bcu drug na tshod la: zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas dbang sdud: g.yon pas thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin: rang rang sa bon thugs kar mtshan: rang 'dra'i ḍā ki 'bum 'bum bskor: dpa' bo ging gi tshogs dang bcas: snang srid dbang sdud rang bzhin du: gar stabs shigs se sgyur bar sgoms: skyed dang ye shes gnyis med pas: spyan drangs bzhugs gsol bya mi dgos: nyams dang rig pa dpa' gding bskyed: che btsan thams cad bran bzhin bsam: gong bzhin rtsa sngags drag tu bzlas: yang na yig bzhi 1$0000230ha ri ni sa/1$0000300 dkrug ste bzlas: bskyed rim 'di yi nga rgyal gyis: ci la'ang thogs rdugs yod mi bsam: rig pa hur bton hūm̐ phaṭa brjod: gang la mi phod thog brdzis na: dngos grub chen po bdud kyis ster: ma yengs ting 'dzin rig gsal gdab: 'di dus yengs na dam tshig nyams: thod rnga bsgrag cing gling bu 'bud: gu gul nag po'i gsur dud bdug: 'di skad byin chen dbab par bya'o: hūm̐: bzhengs shig bzhengs shig rje btsun bzhengs: dgongs shig bla ma rje btsun dgongs: rig 'dzin gnas nas sku skyod cig: rtsa ba gsum gyi dngos grub zhu: dbu la thor tshugs rgyan gyis brgyan: rin chen rgyan cha khra la la: gser gyi gdu bu si li li: rgyan cha mang po pu ru ru: glu len gar byed khyugs se khyug: rol mo mang po di ri ri: yi dam lha yi 'khor gyis bskor: ma dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis gtibs: chos skyong tshogs rnams bran du khol: dpa' bos bro rdung khrabs se khrab: dpa' mos gar byed khyugs se khyug: zhub chen stong dang si li li: mkha' 'gro 'bum dang spungs se spung: lha srin sde brgyad sha ra ra: g.yas nas pho rgyud thibs se thib: g.yon nas mo rgyud thibs se thib: dar gyi ru mtshon lhabs se lhab: dri zhim ngad pa thu lu lu: mkha' 'gro'i brda skad di ri ri: dpa' bo'i shugs glu kyu ru ru:

hūm̐ gi snang glu di ri ri: phaṭa kyi brda skad sangs se sang: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi skur: mos pa'i bu la byin gyis rlobs: sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis rlobs: dbang bzhi rdzogs par bdag la skur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: bzhengs shig yi dam lha tshogs bzhengs: dgongs shig rgyal ba rigs lnga dgongs: rkyen zlog rdo rje drag mo rtsal: mkha' 'gro gtsug gi rgyan gcig ma: chos kyi dbyings nas sku skyod 'tshal: dbu la thor tshugs 1$0000230sogs man chad 'gre'o: 1$0000300hūm̐: bzhengs shig ye shes mkha' 'gro bzhengs: dgongs shig rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: ye shes mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i tshogs: dur khrod gnas nas sku skyod 'tshal: dbu la thor tshugs 1$0000230sogs= 1$0000300oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ sku yis byin gyis brlab tu gsol: lus kyi sgrib pa sbyang du gsol: sku mi 'gyur tshe yi dngos grub stsol: āḥ gsung gis byin gyis brlab tu gsol: ngag gi sgrib pa sbyang du gsol: gsung snying po lung gi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐ thugs kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol: sems kyi sgrib pa sbyang du gsol: skye med rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: hrī: sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis rlobs: ye shes lnga yi dbang skur cig: gsol 'debs brgyud 'dzin byin gyis rlobs: dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par skur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hrīḥm pheṃ pheṃ kā bā tsi sid+dhi hūm̐ ā: de skad gsol ba btab rjes la: mchod pa'i bye brag 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: ma gcig jo mo 'khor dang bcas: phyi nang gsang mchod tshogs la rol: thugs dam gnyan skongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad sol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥm puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai bid+ya shab+da pū tsa ho:

badz+ra ni ra ti hūm̐: gu ru rkyen zlog drag mo rtsal: badz+ra ma ma yaṃ dzaḥha ri ni sa hūm̐: ma hā ba liṃ ta a mṛta ma hā rak+ta bo dhi tsit+ta i daṃ sarba pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐: ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ khā hi khā hi: ma hā sid+dhi ā yur sid+dhi dzñā na sid+dhi sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ ā: de ltar mchod tshogs phul rjes la: mkha' 'gro'i spyi lung dbang gi sgrom: rang nyid zhu zhing gzhan la bskur: bla ma yi dam spyan drangs nas: gsol ba 'di bzhin gdab par bya'o: byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la: sngon tshe ji ltar dbang bskur pas: bdag kyang lha mor dbang bskur zhing: dngos grub mchog kyang bstsal du gsol: de ltar gsol ba gdab par bya: lan du bla ma nyid kyis kyang: dbyer med chen por dbang bskur bas: gsang gsum gnas nas byung ba yi: rtsa ba gsum gyi dam bsrung na: sangs rgyas kun gyi dbang sbyin bya: gnang ba thob nas 'di ltar ro: bla ma thugs ka'i rta mgrin las: rigs lnga yab yum bum pa thogs: bdag gi spyi bor bdud rtsi'i dbang: blugs pas tshangs bug nang du babs: lus kyi sdig sgrib dag par bsam: chu rngub mtha' ma spyi gtsug 'khyil: oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā lnga las: ye shes lnga yis dbur brgyan bsam: des ni bum pa'i dbang thob cing: sku yi dngos grub thob pa yin: bla ma yi dam skur bsgom ste:1$0000230 'di'i dus su jo mo'i thugs kar gu ru bskyed jo mo dang sbyor ba mdzad par bsgom: 1$0000300sbyor mtshams byang sems dkar dmar 'dres: bdag gi lce thog babs par bsam: rang lus bde bas rgyas par bsgom: ngag gi sgrib dag gsang dbang thob: gsung gi dngos grub thob par bsam: de nas bla ma'i thugs ka nas: 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phros pas: bdag gi snying gar phog cing thim: gsal la 'dzin med bde nyams skyes: yid kyi sgrib pa dag par bsam: shes rab ye shes dbang thob cing:

thugs kyi dngos grub thob pa yin: de nas bla ma rang la tshur: thim pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi: sgrib pa ma rig dri ma dag: dran rtog dbyings su thim par bsam: rig pa khong glod rang sems nyid: ma bcos spros bral ngang la bzhag: rig pa ye shes dbang thob cing: mchog gi dngos grub thob pa yin: dbang rdzogs bla mar dbang yon gyis: mnyes par bya ba shin tu gces: bla ma'i dam tshig ci gsung bsgrub: yi dam dam tshig sgrub la brtson: ḍā ki'i dam tshig gsang thub pa: sku gsung thugs dang mnyam par sbyor: de nas gtor tshogs dngos grub blang: gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki nī 1$0000230 gtor ma mi gtang bar tshogs kyi phud bcad la sbyin sreg bya'o: lhag ma dang tshogs la rol te sngags 'dis bya'o: 1$0000300sarba sid+dhi ma hā pha la a la la ho: rol pas bdag mchod kun mnyes bsam: de nas snang srid dbang sdud pa'i: sbyin sreg brtsam ste thab zla gam: dbus su hrīḥbris ma dang sprad: jo mo 'khor bcas der bzhugs bsam: seng ldeng shug pa'i me yang sbar: gong bzhin gsol btab rol mo bsgrag: bsreg rdzas phye ma sha khrag chang: gtor phud rin chen mer dor bas: jo mo 'khor bcas mchod pas mnyes: slar yang dngos grub char ltar phab: sems kyi gding bskyed sngags 'di bzla: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥm ha ri ni sa gu lu gu lu ma ma bha tri: ma ma tsa shi: mi snying sgul: mi 'gram chog: hring hring: sdus sdus: nṛ ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥdza: nṛ ā kar+ṣa ya hring hring: badz+ra sid+dhi ā be sha ya hrīḥswā hā: de ltar sbyin sreg las tshar nas: mjug sdud rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni: snang srid rang gis bskyed pa'i phyir: rang nyid gsal stong 'dzin med bsgom: ma rtogs gnyis 'dzin rang sar dag: snang ba stong par rdzogs pas rdzogs: snang srid thams cad stong par rdzogs: rdzogs rim byed 'dzin rnam dag nas: rang bzhin blo bral ngo bo gnyis su med:

thams cad gnyis med rgya yis thebs: snyem med gtad yengs dang bral bas: bdag 'dzin re dogs gnyis bral bas: de ltar sgrubs shig dgongs ldan ma: de ltar bsgrubs pa'i yon tan yang: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang: skad cig nyid dang mi 'bral zhing: dbang bzhi rang rdzogs don dbang thob: lha srin bran byed shes rab skyed: lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du 'gyur: 'jig rten zas nor char ltar babs: khyad par bud med tshogs rnams 'du: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub thob: bde ba chen po'i don chen rtogs: mtsho rgyal ma yis bu bzhin skyong: gtsug gi rgyan gcig las bzhi 'grub: de phyir nang sgrub 'di la 'bad: bkra shis 'dren khyod skal ba bzang: mkha' 'gro'i dril sgrub mtsho rgyal srog: snying bzhin 'chang la gter du sbos: zhes gsungs so: ma gcig jo mo'i nang sgrub khyad par gyi le'u ste gsum pa'o: ྈྈྈ ma hā gu ru pad+ma la: bkra shis 'dren gyis yang gsol pa: jo mo'i gsang sgrub gsung bar zhu: ma hā gu rus bka' bstsal pa: dge ldan sems ma yang nyon cig: ma gcig jo mo mtsho rgyal ni: gsang bar ma mo bdag med ma: 'khor ba blos btang gangs brag gi: ri khrod dben sar 'bol gdan steng: gsang sngags bla ma bzang bsten nas: gtsug gi rgyan gcig bdag med ma: rang dang gnyis med blta 'dod na: 'di ltar bdag la gzhig pa btang: phyi nang yul la bdag tshol cig: snang yul sems la phar brtags pas: snang ba'i yul la bdag med na: ming rus bdag tu 'dug gam ltos: ming dang rus ni bdag yin na: ming rus 'pho tshe bdag mi 'pho: de phyir ming rus bdag ma yin: lus 'di bdag tu 'dug gam ltos: lus 'di bdag nyid yin gyur na: lus 'di bsregs tshe bdag mi tshig: phyi yi lus ni bdag ma yin: 'o na sems ni bdag yin nam: sems 'di bdag gcig yin gyur na: da lta gar gnas dang po gang nas byung: rjes la gar 'gro dbyibs dang kha dog ltos:

gang du yang ni grub pa med: sems ni stong pa skye 'gag med: de phyir sems la nga bdag med: gzhan na'ang yod pa ma yin te: de ltar lta byed bdag ma yin: ci ste rang bzhin brjod dang bral: bdag med pa la bdag bzung bas: sems can thams cad 'khrul cing sdug: nyon mongs brgyad khri bzhi stong yang: rtsa ba bdag tu rtog las gyes: bdag med rang rig de rtogs na: sangs rgyas byang chub bde ba rgyas: chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong yang: bdag med zad sar skyol la 'dus: de phyir ma mo bdag med ma: ma ni skye ba med pa'i don: mo ni 'gag pa med pa'i don: bdag med skye 'gag gnyis las 'das: de ltar rtogs na lta ba yin: rang rig bdag med gsal ba de: ma yengs rgyun du sgom pa yin: de las mi 'da' dam tshig yin: yid la mi byed gegs sel yin: de bzhin spyad pa spyod pa yin: de don mngon gyur 'bras bu yin: de ni theg pa kun gyi gtsug: mya ngan 'das pa'i rgyan gcig yin: bdag med yongs grol ngo mtshar che: bdag med dbang thob chos sku yin: ji ltar nam mkha' dwangs pa la: nyi ma'i 'od zer 'char ba bzhin: gzugs sku rnam gnyis shugs la 'byung: 'gro don lhun grub chen por spyod: 'di lta bu yi rin chen 'di: blo dman rnams la gsang ba'i don: skal ldan 'di spyod gsang sgrub ces: tha snyad tsam du btags pa bas: de phyir gsang sgrub 'di ltar rtogs: bkra shis 'dren khyod skal ldan nam: gtsug gi rgyan gcig rnal 'byor ma: bdag med pa yi don rtogs shog: jo mo'i gsang sgrub yang dag don gyi le'u ste bzhi pa'o:1$0000230 dpe gcig la/ zla 'od gzhon nu'i sprul pa mon tsan+d+ras yi ger btab pa'o: mchan/ 1$0000300sa ma ya: i thi: rgya rgya rgya:
gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug gi gter ma'o/// /
